name: RAW — Standard Conditions for Civil Engineering Works
description: Validates BOQ items and specifications for civil engineering (grond-, water- en wegenbouw, GWW) against the RAW systematiek published by CROW. Checks that RAW bestekssystematiek is followed, that catalogus entries reference valid RAW chapter codes, that measurement and payment rules (verrekenartikelen) follow RAW conventions, and that the RAW edition year is current.
regulator: CROW (kennisorganisatie voor infrastructuur, verkeer en openbare ruimte)
